config.indestructiblespawners.title: Indestructible Spawners
config.indestructiblespawners.server_not: These settings apply to your singleplayer worlds and to LAN worlds you host. On a dedicated server, edit config/indestructiblespawners.json on the server instead, then restart it.
config.indestructiblespawners.hardness_n: Hardness of each block in each difficulty. -1 makes the block indestructible like bedrock: no mining outside creative, no explosions, no Wither, no Ender Dragon. Hardcore uses the Hard value.
config.indestructiblespawners.hardness.t:
-1: indestructible, like bedrock.
0 or more: hardness used for mining instead (explosions, the Wither and the Ender Dragon then work as in vanilla).
Vanilla hardness: 5.
